approval.scope: Exact reviewed English copy, one image, ALT; standalone @LeoGuoLabs post

final_text:
Claude may be getting a new voice experience. A hidden “Voice” tab marked “Preview” has surfaced in its web interface.

Claude already supports two-way voice conversations. What this new interface adds, when it ships, and whether Anthropic is building its own speech models are still unconfirmed.

What I’d like: talk through an idea, change direction mid-sentence, and keep a coding session moving without reaching for the keyboard. Voice could make that feel much more natural.

media.alt: Screenshot of Claude’s web interface with a Voice item labeled Preview in the left sidebar. The main area shows a chat input and a temporary capacity notice. A TestingCatalog watermark appears at the upper right.

video: No video in supplied or relevant original post

verification.limitations: Hidden Preview label is evidence of an interface entry, not public availability. Own speech model and robot claims unconfirmed. Voice-training toggle omitted because current official documentation did not establish its scope.
